annotations.title: What Taseli knows about the business

description: The business card every Taseli decision starts from: offer, area, customers, voice, the economics (margin, customer value, the cost per result or ROAS that breaks even), each ad account's goal, target and monthly budget, the owner's own rules and preferences (they outrank best practice), what was tried and how it went, and open questions. Read only.

account.description: An ad account's name, when it is about one account only; omit when it is about the whole business.
